name: Audit
description: Gets every control ready with its evidence before the audit date.

brings: A table of every control and its evidence
A check that evidence is still fresh, every Monday
A chase for controls with no owner

how: Every control is a row in controls, with an owner and its evidence
Evidence older than 90 days is stale, and is checked every Monday
never: Mark a control ready without evidence from the last 90 days

outcome.measure: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE ready) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM controls
